text:
Sam.Sales: Heads up — POC kickoff with CrossOrg tomorrow 10am PST. They've uploaded a long security questionnaire and a list of technical asks: SSO (SAML) assertion/attribute limits, SCIM delta window & retry behavior, RBAC mapping (IdP groups -> Redwood roles), domain proofing, and provisioning throughput. Can we align on short answers for presales?
Maria.Solutions: TL;DR of their items I pulled out: 1) Max SAML assertion size & recommendations for group claims 2) SCIM rate limits / delta semantics 3) RBAC mapping examples and admin UX 4) Whether heavy provisioning needs Dedicated or Private capacity 5) Data residency / KMS / HSM question in security questionnaire.
Raj.SE: SCIM summary: hosted default rate limit = 600 reqs/min per tenant token, burst allowed by token bucket. Delta support uses meta.lastModified and we accept since= timestamp queries. For very large orgs (>50k users) recommend an initial full-sync via bulk import or scheduled paged requests; otherwise set delta cadence to every 5 minutes. We support pagination via startIndex+count and conditional requests with If-None-Match/ETag.
Cody.Engineering: Note on SAML: extremely large assertions (>>16KB) can hit IdP or nginx limits and slow down parsing. Recommend sending minimal group references (IDs) instead of full expanded lists when >200 groups per assertion. Also avoid embedding huge JSON blobs in an attribute. If necessary use a group_refs claim: groups=["grp-234","grp-345"].
Sam.Sales: @Nina.Security please confirm KMS/HSM wording for the questionnaire. They asked whether hosted supports customer-managed HSM and what audit logs we retain.
Nina.Security: Hosted: we do not offer customer-managed HSM; we integrate with customer KMS in Private deployments (BYOK) and Private supports HSM-backed key stores. Audit logs: admin/audit events are retained 90 days by default; enterprise add-on supports extended retention and S3 export. I'll post formal wording in this thread in 30m.
Maria.Solutions: RBAC mapping options we can propose in the POC: 1) SCIM group -> Redwood role mapping (automated via group.externalId or displayName) 2) Admin Console mapping (manual mapping UI) 3) Hybrid: initial mapping via SCIM then allow overrides in UI. For the demo, we'll show a CSV->SCIM seed for 10k users and mapping validation.
Raj.SE: SCIM edgecases: if the customer's IdP sends events out of order, we rely on meta.lastModified monotonicity and ETags; advise NTP-synced clocks and avoid clock skew >30s. For flaky networks, implement exponential backoff with jitter and honor Retry-After header on 429/503.
Sam.Sales: They mentioned an initial provisioning load: 500k accounts plus 20k daily delta changes. Does that necessitate Dedicated? @Cody.Engineering?
Cody.Engineering: For sustained high provisioning throughput, recommend Dedicated or Private. Dedicated provides reserved capacity and predictable API throughput for provisioning-heavy workloads and avoids noisy-neighbor throttling. Hosted can absorb bulk imports with rate limiting but expect longer sync windows and potential throttling; Dedicated monthly commit vs hosted overage cost will vary — I'll fetch ballpark numbers and post within the hour.
Maria.Solutions: POC checklist I'm proposing: 1) Domain proofing: have them add DNS TXT record for demo domain demo.crossorg.example; we'll verify. 2) SAML: request a sample (sanitized) assertion so we can test attribute mapping. 3) SCIM: ask for a 10k-user CSV to run a representative import. 4) RBAC: provide a small mapping table (IdP group -> role) for the demo. 5) Security: Nina to provide questionnaire answers.
OpsBot: Deploy bot: Demo env provisioned: demo-crossorg-2026 (expires in 14 days).
Raj.SE: SCIM example curl for delta polling: `GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=meta.lastModified>2026-03-01T12:00:00Z&startIndex=1&count=1000` — use ETag/If-None-Match to reduce payloads. Recommend they paginate and backoff on 429.
Nina.Security: Draft wording for questionnaire: "Hosted deployment: Redwood manages encryption keys; customer-managed HSM is not available in hosted. For Private/VPC deployments we support customer KMS/BYOK and HSM integrations. Admin/audit logs retained 90 days by default; extended retention and S3 export available as an enterprise add-on. SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliant controls are available for enterprise customers; additional compliance packaging can be discussed." I'll refine and post the exact snippet.
Cody.Engineering: If assertion size is an unavoidable issue, we can accept a pointer claim (group_refs) and reconcile groups via SCIM during login flow. That reduces assertion payload and parsing cost.
Sam.Sales: Action items: Maria request sample assertion + domain TXT; Raj to draft SCIM delta guidance & rate plan doc; Nina to draft security questionnaire answers; Cody to pull Dedicated vs Hosted cost/throughput estimates. Post drafts here by EOD — I need final answers for kickoff prep by 9am tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Maria.Solutions: I'll DM crossorg the onboarding checklist and a trimmed presales questionnaire link: https://redwood.ai/docs/presales/scim-saml-auth-playbook
Raj.SE: Posting SCIM delta guidance draft in 20m.

Cody.Engineering: Pinged infra for dedicated commit pricing, will update within the hour.
Sam.Sales: Thanks team — crank those drafts out and drop into this thread.
Maria.Solutions: On it.
